title: Sea Cabbage Angel Wings - 1x Mini Plug Plant - Soft Silver Foliage
description:
Stunning Silver Foliage for Containers and Landscapes!
KEY FEATURES
• Striking silver-white, velvety foliage
• Excellent for containers and landscape focal points
• Heat and drought tolerant
• Deer and rabbit resistant
• Low maintenance and easy to grow
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Cacti & Succulents — Senecio candicans 'Angel Wings'
Colour: Silver (foliage)
Season: Spring, Summer (grown for foliage)
Growth Habit: Mounded
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun to Partial shade
Soil: Well-drained, sandy or loamy soil
Watering: Average; prefers moist to dry soil, does not tolerate consistently wet conditions. Drought tolerant once established.
Spacing: 30-41 cm (12-16 inches)
Height: 30-46 cm (12-18 inches)
Spread: 30-41 cm (12-16 inches)
Hardiness: USDA Zones 8-11 (often grown as an annual in cooler climates)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in well-draining soil; amend with grit or perlite if necessary.
• Ensure good air circulation and avoid overwatering, especially in pots.
• Water regularly when establishing, then allow soil to dry slightly between waterings.
• Protect from heavy rain and hard frosts in cooler zones by moving pots indoors or providing cover.
• Remove any faded or yellowing leaves to maintain plant health and appearance.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
1x Mini Plug Plant
